interface.shortDescription: Use Google-grounded search first for modern products and current facts.
interface.longDescription: Google Grounded Search Copilot gives Codex a structured MCP tool for source-backed current information. The tool delegates login and token refresh to Hermes' google-antigravity provider, then forces Gemini native Google Search grounding for the search request. Codex should use it before answering modern product, company, model, release, latest/current/search/source/verification questions and keep final judgment, synthesis, and safety boundaries in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Tell me about this modern product with Google-grounded sources.
Search the latest official sources with Google grounding.
Verify this claim with source URLs.
